en.headline: 14 own commits plus 22 automated, 3 issues, 1 discussion started
en.summary: On 2026-10-16 the user logged **14 own commits** across two personal repos, plus 22 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` (7 own commits) the work was documentation-heavy: adding `AGENTS.md`, introducing a `knowledge/` base for Git & GitHub findings with Excalidraw sketches, generalizing the knowledge scope beyond Git/GitHub, making knowledge supplementation a default action in the agents doc, and archiving OpenCode V2 distribution/architecture/auth notes plus oh-my-opencode-slim and hosted-OpenCode findings. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` (7 own commits) the user added a `--force` flag to the daily CLI to skip comment-count snapshot freezing and to re-fetch finalized-day comment snapshots, fixed candidate filtering so items are no longer dropped when `updated_at` falls outside the window, extracted a shared `lib/days.mjs` helper to generalize the AI-generation entry point, tightened comment-count semantics and target lookup per review feedback, fixed a +08 early-morning reply-collection gap, and shipped a new 30-day GitHub activity AI summary as both a homepage card and a standalone page.

zh.headline: 14 次本人提交加 22 次自动提交，3 个 issue，1 个讨论
zh.summary: 2026-10-16 当天，用户在两个个人仓库中共完成 **14 次本人提交**，另有 22 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`（7 次本人提交）中，工作以文档为主：新增 `AGENTS.md`，建立 `knowledge/` 目录用于归档 Git & GitHub 相关发现并附 Excalidraw 草图，将 knowledge 范围从 Git/GitHub 泛化为「各种知识」，在 agents 文档中将 knowledge 补充设为默认动作，并归档 OpenCode V2 分发/架构/认证与 Windows 路径坑、oh-my-opencode-slim 与托管 OpenCode 实测知识。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`（7 次本人提交）中，用户为 daily CLI 增加 `--force` 参数以跳过评论数快照冻结并重取定稿日评论数快照，修复候选条目不再按 `updated_at` 是否落在窗口内过滤的问题，抽出共享助手 `lib/days.mjs` 以通用化 AI 生成入口，按复审意见收紧评论数口径与 target 检索，修复 +08 凌晨漏采回复的问题，并新增近 30 天 GitHub 活动 AI 总结（首页卡片 + 独立页）。Issue 方面，用户在 `anomalyco/opencode` 中涉及 3 项：新开 `#55785` 反映 `mimo-v2.6-flash` 与 `mimo-v2.5` 声明支持图像输入但 Go 端点返回 400，新开 `#55772` 请求为 Windows 桌面版内置的 CLI 提供运行方式，并在 `#55785` 上留言。用户还在 `openchamber/openchamber` 中发起了讨论 `#4982`，标题为 "Share session archive state with OpenCode's own clients"。用户的 issue 共收到 4 条回复，来自 `micahgerges`（在 `#55785` 上给出 2x2 对照测试与隔夜行为变化两条跟进）、`opencode-agent[bot]`（`#55785`）以及 `opencode-agent[bot]`（`#55772`）。当天无 PR、无 review、无 release，且各采集段均未触及上限。
